affected_subject.reason: Identifies L2TokenReceiverV2 and its increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() function.

trigger_or_action.reason: Calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange with hardcoded deadline lets MEV bot hold and execute the tx later.

direct_effect.reason: Transaction never expires and executes with stale pricing, enabling MEV value extraction.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected Uniswap V3 deadline expiration check (block.timestamp <= deadline) is always true, violating temporal safety model.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable function, the hardcoded deadline trigger, the resulting non-expiring transaction with stale execution, and the violated Uniswap V3 deadline safety relation.
